name: chaise sofa
caption: A chaise sofa with a long chaise cushion, a back and two arms. Cushions rest on the seat frame; a rear backrest and both arms join it. Rounded cushions keep an even thickness and attach continuously to the frame. Overall width is 2.10 times depth; height is 0.47 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous cream, dark brown, brown color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
